Hi Lucy —

Thanks again for coordinating with Cindera. We want to run a short co-sell dry rehearsal ahead of the customer walkthrough to validate the runbook and fallbacks (especially for multi-region failover). Proposed scope: 30–45 minute dry run for internal + SI tech handoff, then a 60-minute customer walkthrough the following week.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm which Cindera attendees need the dry-run (AE, solution architect, product owner)?
- Share two 1-hour windows next week that work for your team (preferably EU overlap 09:00–13:00 CET).

Attached is the customer-facing deck and a first-pass runbook we want to exercise (Cindera-RW-demo-deck.pdf; demo-dryrun-runbook_v1.docx).

Tentative hosts from our side: Vanessa (ops lead) + Karthik (SI coordination). I can facilitate the dry-run and manage fallback policy if we need to move to an Azure-hosted fallback.

Thanks — Rafael
